title: The Common Toilet Mistake Causing Silent Leaks
description: Drop-in chemical toilet tablets might seem like a convenient way to keep your bathroom fresh, but placing them inside your toilet tank is one of the most common causes of plumbing leaks. When the toilet sits unused, concentrated chemicals in the tablet slowly degrade rubber flappers, fill valve seals, and tank-to-bowl gaskets. Over time, the rubber warps and hardens, preventing a tight seal and causing a constant, silent leak into the bowl that inflates your water bill. For daily maintenance, stick to manual bowl cleaners or rim-hung clips, and inspect your tank flapper annually.
